description: Use when you need bulk email validation, email list verification or to verify email lists before a send or import. Do not use for one address (email-check is cheaper), proving a mailbox exists (no SMTP probe) or sending email. Returns JSON checking up to 20 email addresses in one call: syntax, MX records, disposable, free and role flags, SPF, DMARC and a verdict each, plus counts by verdict for 0.02 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.02 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

emails.description: Email addresses to check, 1 to 20, e.g. ["jane@example.com", "info@ietf.org"]
